'''Qayhuk''' was the Secretary of the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] [[Council of Elders (Yinchorri)|Council of Elders]]. He petitioned [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] for help in admitting [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
